notes: §2002:13.16.49.3 GR1 evaluates file-section SELECT WHEN clauses for every READ, REWRITE and WRITE of a CODE-SET/FORMAT file, record-name forms included: REWRITE REC-A selects REC-B (OTHER) and converts its one display byte ('MEDIUM 1 194', the rest unconverted), a WRITE of an unselected record answers 45, and READ selects A/B/OTHER in order. All three cases run at --std 2002 on the pinned build match their 2002 goldens.
